claims.text: Charon is said to have allowed the Puppeteers only because they stood with the other Guilds at a time when Charon could not move against all of them; that bond still helps them survive.

Several Heretic cults that favor contact with the living, against the Dictum Mortuum, hide Puppeteers from their foes, and some Puppeteers take part, calling it a religious duty even when it endangers their hosts.
Of all the Guilds only the Pardoners are cool toward them, though each needs the other's services and stays civil in public.

title: Puppeteers in the Fifth Maelstrom
summary: Why many Puppeteers stayed out of the storm.

claims.text: Many Puppeteers saw no reason to aid the Hierarchy and kept to protecting their own during the Maelstrom of the Second World War.
One small band led by Lance Salles went to help against advice, and nearly all of them became Spectres; after that the Guild sent no more rescue missions.
